purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche O benchmark authored only after r25 production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded; it was not used to construct r25.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after production verification of r25 and was not used to construct r25.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: armistice banked = nobody can start a battle?

cases.question: no gambit, brothers in arms can give +1 tactic from hand?
